rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site LEAP cohort; multiple European sites listed for MRI acquisition.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS multisite Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP)"; "MRI data were acquired on 3T scanners at multiple sites in Europe-King's College London (KCL), Radboud University Nijmegen Medical Centre (RUNMC), University Medical Centre Utrecht (UMCU), Autism Research Centre (ARC), University of Cambridge (UCAM), Central Institute of Mental Health, Mannheim (CIMH), and Karolinska Institutet (KI)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: LEAP project dataset used as the normative reference cohort.

rci5_n.detail: Overall typically developing controls from LEAP after QC; not all participants completed all fMRI sessions.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The above criteria resulted in the inclusion of data for analyses from the following participants: 282 participants with autism ... and 221 typically developing controls"; "Not every participant was included in each analysis, for the reason that not all participants completed all fMRI scan sessions."

rci6_sex.detail: Overall typically developing controls; male percentage reported, counts derived from total N=221.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "221 typically developing controls (age range 6.9-29.8 years; mean = 17.0; sd = 5.5; 63.8% male)."

rci7_age.detail: Overall typically developing controls; age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "221 typically developing controls (age range 6.9-29.8 years; mean = 17.0; sd = 5.5; 63.8% male)."
